subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: Yahoo: The Web's First Directory
description: A fast breakdown of Yahoo: The Web's First Directory for builders.

hook.text: In 1994, two Stanford students started organizing websites into categories by hand.

buildup.text: Jerry Yang and David Filo built Yahoo as a human-curated directory of the growing web.

discovery.text: Yahoo became the starting page for millions. If your site was listed, traffic poured in.

twist.text: Yahoo turned down a chance to buy Google for $1 million in 1998. It was 'too small.'

climax.text: Human curation couldn't scale. Algorithms replaced librarians, and Yahoo faded into history.

punchline.text: The web's first guide couldn't keep up with it.
